name: golem-workspace

scripts.build: npm run build -w @exprtlabs/golem && tsc -p packages/golem-model/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/golem-openapi/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/golem-ts-openapi/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:tests: npm run build && npm run build:scripts && node .build/scripts/clean-tests.js && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.bench: npm run build && npm run build:scripts && node .build/scripts/benchmark/run.js
scripts.bench:handwritten: npm run build && npm run build:scripts && node .build/scripts/benchmark/typia-validation.js
scripts.bench:release: npm run build && npm run build:scripts && node .build/scripts/benchmark/release-check.js
scripts.generate:examples: npm run build && npm run build:scripts && node .build/scripts/examples.js generate
scripts.docs:build: npm run generate:openapi-compliance && vitepress build docs
scripts.lint: npm run build && npm run build:scripts && node .build/scripts/check-imports.js

description: Generate OpenAPI from TypeScript controllers and generate TypeScript models and API clients, with validation, serialization and optional MobX integration.
